title: Distance: 6 km
author: Amin
description: A peaceful crescent-shaped beach surrounded by cliffs and greenery. Ideal for sunset views, swimming, or simply disconnecting from the crowds in a quiet, scenic setting.

title: Distance: 10 km
author: Mack
description: One of Gokarna’s most sacred landmarks, this ancient temple is home to the revered Atmalinga. A must-visit for those seeking spirituality, history, and a glimpse into the town’s cultural soul.

title: Distance: 7 km
author: Rubel
description: Famous for its natural Om-shaped shoreline, this is one of Gokarna’s most iconic beaches. Perfect for relaxing, light water activities, and enjoying beachside cafés with ocean views.

title: Distance: 6 km
author: Ashiq
description: A laid-back, palm-lined beach known for calm waters and beautiful sunsets. Great for long walks, quiet evenings, and a slower, more relaxed beach experience.

title: Distance: 21 km
author: Ashiq
description: A 16th-century historic fort surrounded by lush greenery and massive laterite walls. Ideal for photography, heritage walks, and exploring the region’s rich past.
